entries.name: Werewolves
entries.content:
An lycanthrope. Basically an person whom can transform into an rather big wolf, although pelts, eyes, sizes and personalities may differ this trait is only passed down through genetics. Werewolves usually have fluffy coats but it depends on the environment so said lycanthropes have to endure. Hotter climates will have an shorter coat while colder climates tend to be very fluffy.

lycanthropes tend to be territorial IF they established an territory often only chasing threats out, but in some rare cases they will kill other lycanthropes on their territory and will kill any unrelated offspring that isn’t theirs.
